name: Mall or Nothing
description: The first job of GTA Online: a sedan race through Los Santos against Lamar and other new arrivals.

name: Hold Up
description: Lamar points you at a corner store to rob as an introduction to quick freemode crime.

name: Ballas to the Wall
description: Repossess a purple Schafter from a Ballas street in Rancho and bring it back to the dealership.

name: San Andreas Seoul
description: Hijack a fuel tanker near Little Seoul, shake off the police and haul it to the depot.

name: Ticket to Elysium
description: Intercept a chemical tanker heading for the Palmer-Taylor power station, escape the cops and deliver it.

name: Going Down the GOH
description: Steal a tanker cruising the Great Ocean Highway and take it to the El Burro depot.

name: Caught Napping
description: Pull Lamar's friend Leroy out of a Ballas van and drive him safely back to his store.

name: Lost MC RIP
description: Ambush the Lost MC at a cemetery in Pacific Bluffs and wipe them out.

name: No Smoking
description: Grab a trailer full of Redwood cigarettes from the El Burro rail yard and bring it to the depot.

name: Learning the Ropes
description: Gerald's introductory job: crash a Vagos and Ballas meeting, take the drugs and bring them to his place.

name: Pier Pressure
description: Hit a meth deal at Del Perro Pier and get the product back to Gerald's apartment.

name: Death Metal
description: Break up a Ballas deal at a scrapyard and steal the cocaine for Gerald.

name: Deal Breaker
description: Interrupt a Ballas and Vagos exchange in a gas company yard and make off with the coke.

name: Flood in the LS River
description: Ambush a Lost MC and Vagos meet down in the Los Santos storm drain and take their meth.

name: Meth'd Up
description: Steal a meth-lab RV from a caravan out in Sandy Shores and drive it to the pickup.

name: No Hay Bronca
description: Save Gerald's associate Stanley from a bad deal, recover the package and take down the fleeing gang leader.

name: Gassed Up
description: Stop a Vagos cocaine handoff at a Cypress Flats gas plant and steal the product.

name: Hit 'Em Up
description: Take out a list of named Ballas in a set order without spooking the rest, then finish off the gang.

name: Violent Duct
description: Raid a Lost MC deal in Mission Row and run the cocaine back to Gerald.

name: Hard Labor
description: Fight floor by floor up a La Puerta construction site and kill the gang boss on the roof.

name: War and Pieces
description: Steal the Lost MC's cocaine at a desert trailer park and deliver it to Gerald's apartment.

name: Chumash and Grab
description: Clear Vagos off the Chumash pier and the boat moored there, then sail the boat to the drop-off.

name: Dish the Dirt
description: Eliminate the snipers and heavies guarding a Vagos deal in the desert and bring back the package.

name: Where Credit's Due
description: Repossess a Zion from a lot on Carson Avenue, lose the police and bring it to Premium Deluxe Motorsport.

name: Rockford Roll
description: Take back a Cabrio parked at the Rockford Hotel and return it to Simeon after losing the cops.

name: Rich Men in Richman
description: Hack the gate of a Richman mansion and drive off with two cars owed to Simeon.

name: Chasers
description: Recover a black Coquette for Simeon, then evade the police on the way back.

name: It Takes a Thief
description: Retrieve a stolen Jackal and Coquette from the thieves and deliver both to the dealership.

name: Gentry Does It
description: Pull luxury cars out of the Gentry Manor hotel and get them back to Premium Deluxe.

name: All in the Game
description: Repossess a silver Baller from a rough neighbourhood and deliver it to Simeon.

name: El Burro Heists
description: Grab an orange Dominator from El Burro Heights for the dealership.

name: Blow Up
description: Wreck the stock at a rival dealership in Davis, lose the cops and return to Simeon.

name: GTA Today
description: Steal a shopping list of vehicles and get them onto a boat at the docks before it sails.

name: Chasers II
description: Retrieve a yellow Tornado from South Los Santos and deliver it to the dealership.

name: Blow Up II
description: Take a Banshee from a Downtown Vinewood lot and destroy every other car there before escaping.

name: Blow Up III
description: Destroy a shipment of imported cars at the port terminal, then report back to the dealership.

name: ATV Steal
description: A removed Simeon job where players stole ATVs from a race near Raton Canyon and took them to Paleto Cove.

name: Romance Isn't Dead
description: Steal a van from the Lost MC and drive it to Trevor's trailer.

name: Fuelling the Flames
description: Take a fuel tanker from the Harmony depot and deliver it to Ron's gas station.

name: Turbine Carbine
description: Head to the wind farm, steal a van and bring it back to Trevor's trailer.

name: Daemon Run
description: Steal Lost MC motorcycles from their trailer park and hand them over to Mushroom Hank.

name: Base Invaders
description: Fly into Fort Zancudo, destroy the parked Lazer jets and escape with a Cargobob.

name: Crank Up the Volume
description: Steal the Lost MC's meth-lab RV and drive it to Ron's lab.

name: Landing Gear
description: Steal planes from Sandy Shores Airfield and land them at the docks while a ground player guides them in.

name: Wet Workers
description: Grab the Lost MC's boat in Paleto Cove, deliver it to the meth lab and fight off the bikers.

name: A Boat in the Bay
description: A removed Ron mission that tasked players with stealing a boat and bringing it to a jetty.

name: Lost My Mind
description: Raid a Lost MC hideout, kill the bikers and bring their meth to Trevor's trailer.

name: Crystal Clear Out
description: Storm a drug factory, steal the product and haul it back to Trevor.

name: Chop Chop
description: Fight Merryweather at Sandy Shores Airfield, hack a laptop and destroy two of their outposts.

name: Out of Harmony
description: Steal a trailer, move it to a boatyard, protect the shipment from bikers and hand it to the buyer.

name: Satellite Communications
description: Hijack a trailer loaded with satellite dishes and deliver it to a gas station.

name: Method in the Madness
description: Destroy a rival meth operation's vehicles and gear near Raton Canyon, then take the meth to Trevor.

name: Chopper Tail
description: Chase a helicopter in a Dune Buggy, protect the meth lab and bring the recovered equipment to Trevor.

name: Diamonds are for Trevor
description: Steal a diamond haul, reach the Paleto jetty and escape by boat to the drop-off.

name: Denial of Service
description: Destroy a fleet of surveillance trucks for Lester, then lose the police.

name: Master Data
description: Break into a Banning storage unit, fight the Triads and deliver a data truck to Lester's warehouse.

name: Cops Capacity
description: Collect supplies, wreck police vehicles and get to Lester's safehouse once the heat is off.

name: Crime Scenester
description: Steal marked cash from a La Mesa crime scene and get it to the warehouse after evading the cops.

name: Landing Strip
description: Steal a plane and land it at Sandy Shores Airfield.

name: A Titan of a Job
description: Steal a Titan cargo plane from LSIA and fly it to Sandy Shores.

name: Last Chopper Outta LS
description: Grab a helicopter from a Del Perro rooftop, fight off a rival crew and deliver it.

name: High Priority Case
description: Recover a briefcase from a downtown skyscraper construction site.

name: Quarry Quarry
description: Steal explosive-laden vans from the Davis Quartz quarry and bring one to the warehouse.

name: By Land, Sea and Air
description: Take a helicopter from a Pier 400 rooftop and deliver it to Lester's warehouse.

name: Teaser Trailer
description: Steal a trailer in Cypress Flats and haul it to the warehouse.

name: Four Trailers
description: Stop a rival crew raiding weapons trailers in Cypress Flats and bring one trailer back.

name: Bust Out
description: Rescue Gustavo before his prison transfer and escort him to safety.

name: Sinking Feeling
description: Head into a tunnel, steal an SUV and get it to the warehouse.

name: The Parking Garage
description: Take positions in a Pillbox Hill parking garage, eliminate the enemy team and recover a document.

name: Hack and Dash
description: Hack a terminal at a Vinewood Hills compound and drive off with prototype vehicles.

name: On Maneuvers
description: Steal an Annihilator helicopter from an army training ground and fly it to the airfield.

name: Docks to Stock
description: Get a Cargobob, lift a container out of a guarded compound and drop it at the warehouse.

name: Stocks and Scares
description: Hack a terminal and crack a safe in Merryweather's Elysian Island office, then deliver the briefcase.

name: American Exports
description: A removed Lester mission in which players used a Cargobob to lift a shipping container out of LSIA.

name: Chemical Extraction
description: A removed Lester mission: hack into Humane Labs, steal a van and bring it to his desert safehouse.

name: Docks to Stock II
description: A removed sequel where a Cargobob was used to snatch a container from a Merryweather dock compound.

name: On the List
description: Work through a hit list for Madrazo, saving the final target for last.

name: Artificial Scarcity
description: Destroy a row of trucks at the Maibatsu factory.

name: Handle with Care
description: Clear smugglers out of the shipyard, take the cocaine and boat it to the rendezvous.

name: Time To Get Away
description: Rescue El Estupido from a farm and escort him to McKenzie Airfield.

name: Out of Court Settlement
description: Kill a lawyer, take the evidence he was carrying and bring it to Madrazo's ranch.

name: Death From Above
description: Assassinate a target at his mansion, photograph the body and lose the police.

name: Check Out Time
description: Silence a witness for Madrazo, snap proof of the kill and escape the cops.

name: Water the Vineyard
description: Kill a judge at the Marlowe Vineyards and photograph him as proof.

name: Grab Your Ballas
description: Steal a Ballas truck from a loading bay and park it in Madrazo's lockup.

name: Stick Up the Stickup Crew
description: Turn the tables on a robbery crew by stealing their truck at the Port of Los Santos.

name: The Los Santos Connection
description: Ambush a drug deal, trace the supplier, destroy his crew's cars and take him out.

name: Effin' Lazers
description: Jump into Lazer jets at Sandy Shores and shoot down a set of planes and helicopters.

name: Editor and Thief
description: Kill a Daily Globe editor and steal the incriminating photographs he holds.

name: Mixed Up With Coke
description: Destroy cement trucks being used to smuggle cocaine bricks.

name: Dry Docking
description: Crack a safe at the shipyard, steal a boat and take it to the marina.

name: Cleaning the Cat House
description: Rescue Anna from a biker-run motel and bring her to Madrazo.

name: Extradition
description: Break into Fort Zancudo to kill an informant and a district attorney, then grab their briefcase.

name: Holed Up - Burton
description: Clear a rival gang out of an apartment block and escort Juan to safety.

name: Show Me the Monet
description: Steal the car transporting a valuable crate and deliver it to Madrazo's lockup.

name: Judging the Jury
description: Eliminate the jurors on a case Madrazo wants to go away, then lose the police.

name: Defender
description: Fly to the airport, pick up Madrazo's contact and escort him by air to Sandy Shores.

name: Rooftop Rumble
description: Ambush an FIB team in a parking garage and steal their documents.

name: Trash Talk
description: Destroy garbage trucks and break up a rival operation in El Burro Heights, then kill the fleeing boss.

name: Pickup Sticks
description: A removed Madrazo mission where players flew a helicopter around collecting packages for Sandy Shores.

name: Crystal Clear Out II
description: Raid a rival gang's meth cook site in the Senora Desert.

name: Factory Closure
description: Steal motorbikes from a guarded Maibatsu factory in La Mesa.

name: Dirt Road
description: Chase down drug couriers leaving a diner in North Chumash and take their goods.

name: Coasting
description: Intercept a rival's shipment along the Palomino coast.

name: Potshot
description: Hijack a valuable organic crop delivery from Braddock Farm.

name: Close Action
description: Two teams of two raid a Lost MC meth lab, one covering from a hilltop while the other steals the RVs.

name: Coveted
description: Sabotage a rival Cargobob salvage operation east of the wind farm and take the container.

name: Crystal Clear Out III
description: Destroy the Vagos' new meth labs around Blaine County.

name: Truck Together
description: A removed two-team mission where crews fought to drive a truck to Lester's warehouse.

name: Last Play - Bad Companies
description: Hunt Salva henchmen through the Alta construction site and photograph their boss.

name: Last Play - Deal With It
description: Search crates at a drug deal for the product, meet the buyers and destroy the evidence.

name: Last Play - End Product
description: Drive a Mule Custom between deal spots, guard it while buyers arrive and finish at Elysian Island.

name: Last Play - Fast Peddling
description: Steal drugs from rival bikers and regroup at Gerald's apartment.

name: Last Play - Go Figure
description: Find a van, then search several locations for action figures stuffed with drugs.

name: Last Play - Make Ends Meat
description: Break into the Raven Slaughterhouse, crack a safe for a drug formula and beat the gang boss.

name: Repo - Blow Up IV
description: Destroy the vehicles in a warehouse near LSIA, including special cars in the basement, then fight your way out.

name: Repo - Sasquashed
description: Steal a Sasquatch monster truck from Maze Bank Arena, wreck the other vehicles and deliver it to the docks.

name: Repo - Under the Hammer
description: Take a target car out of La Mesa police station, lose the cops and deliver it to the docks.

name: Repo - Do You Even Lift?
description: Find a Cargobob and use it to airlift a target car out of Rockford Hills.

name: Repo - GTA Today II
description: Steal the target vehicle from its location and get it to the docks.

name: Repo - RV Nearly There?
description: Steal a Brickade from Larry's RV Sales in Harmony and drive it to the dealership.

name: Repo - Burn Rate
description: Grab a fire truck, put out fires at the Terminal and take out the remaining enemies.

name: Repo - Simeonomics
description: Steal a target car from Los Santos International Airport and bring it to Simeon.

name: Dispatch I
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Get into the Mission Row police station cells, kill the target held there and escape the cops.

name: Dispatch II
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Crash a Merryweather meeting at their Elysian Island base and kill an FIB agent.

name: Dispatch III
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Eliminate a target at Los Santos International Airport, then lose the police.

name: Dispatch IV
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Kill a dealer at a La Puerta recycling plant and leave the area.

name: Dispatch V
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Track down and kill several targets spread across Los Santos.

name: Dispatch VI
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Take out the final set of targets for Madrazo and shake off the police.

name: Community Outreach
description: Two crews roll out in lowriders to a storage lot, fight off Vagos and Ballas and return to Benny's.

name: Slow and Low
description: Cruise to a deal at Del Perro Pier without drawing police attention, then deal with the Ballas.

name: It's a G Thing
description: Break Gerald out of a van at LSIA and escort him to safety in his lowrider.

name: Funeral Party
description: Hit the Vagos at a gas station, then follow a funeral procession into a graveyard brawl and move the hearse.

name: Lowrider Envy
description: Sneak in through the back of a Ballas spot in La Mesa, kill the guards and destroy a Voodoo.

name: Point and Shoot
description: A sniping job where one player covers the other from a vantage point.

name: Desperate Times Call For...
description: Drive a Moonbeam across town hitting Ballas and the Carlos brothers' crews, then destroy the van in Del Perro.

name: Peace Offerings
description: Steal a Buccaneer, lose the cops, bring it to Benny's and hold off the Vagos.

name: Escape Escort
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Escort clients in a Rumpo to an evacuation point while Ramp Buggy drivers clear the way.

name: Breakdown Recovery
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Steal the Wastelander from its transport truck near Sandy Shores and deliver it.

name: Cleanup Op
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Destroy Lost MC trucks and boats around Millar's Fishery and Lago Zancudo, then deliver a Blazer Aqua.

name: Asset Seizure
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Use the Phantom Wedge to grab drug trolleys from three locations and take them to McKenzie Airfield.

name: Firewall Protection
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Hack targets with the Rocket Voltic and fend off attackers at a SecuroServ base.

name: Coast Guard Duty
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Destroy product aboard a yacht and deliver a Technical Aqua.

name: End of Transmission
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Recover a transmitter from the Palmer-Taylor power station in an Armored Boxville.

name: Arms Embargo
payout: unlocks a discounted price on the featured vehicle
description: Destroy supply trucks, helicopters and a cargo plane around Fort Zancudo with the Ruiner 2000.

name: Severe Weather Patterns
description: Shoot down Merryweather Cargobobs and Titans across Blaine County, then deliver the Dune FAV.

name: Half-Track Bully
description: Approach an enemy base by dinghy, hack and steal a Half-track, then deliver it.

name: Exit Strategy
description: Protect three dignitaries leaving LSIA using the Anti-Aircraft Trailer.

name: Offshore Assets
description: Salvage packages from a sunken freighter with the amphibious APC.

name: Cover Blown
description: Drive the Mobile Operations Center across San Andreas to Elysian Island while dodging missile locks.

name: Mole Hunt
description: Destroy signal jammers to find a rogue agent on Elysian Island and eliminate them using Weaponized Tampas.

name: Data Breach
description: Steal Oppressor bikes from the Los Santos tunnels and load them into a cargo plane.

name: Work Dispute
description: Jump from the cargo plane on Oppressors and destroy rogue Mobile Operations Centers at the docks.

name: Casino - Loose Cheng
description: Track down Tao Cheng at an abandoned motel and escort him to the Diamond.

name: Casino - House Keeping
description: Follow Vincent, knock out a group of hillbillies, recover the Thrax and bring it to the casino.

name: Casino - Strong Arm Tactics
description: Drive Tao to a tense meeting, protect him from Avery's guards and move on to the country club.

name: Casino - Play to Win
description: Destroy Duggan oil tankers and hit the LS State Gas Company.

name: Casino - Bad Beat
description: Defend the Diamond from mercenaries storming the casino.

name: Casino - Cashing Out
description: Raid Avery Duggan's ranch, take out his bodyguards and destroy his escape helicopter.

name: A Superyacht Life - Overboard
description: Deal with joyriders in the Vespucci Canals, recover paperwork and destroy their boats.

name: A Superyacht Life - Salvage
description: Salvage cargo from the Olifantus shipwreck, then fight off hijackers and rescue the yacht crew.

name: A Superyacht Life - All Hands
description: Steal a Tula from LSIA and use it to water-bomb fires at a country club.

name: A Superyacht Life - Icebreaker
description: Sneak into Fridgit Cold Storage, wreck the rooftop AC units and steal a Benson for a buyer.

name: A Superyacht Life - Bon Voyage
description: Clear armed enemies who have taken over the yacht.

name: A Superyacht Life - D-Day
description: Use the Kraken submersible to slip past the yacht's defences, then kill the boss and down his helicopter.

name: On Course
description: Meet Dr. Dre at the Los Santos Golf Club and deal with two golfers getting in the way.

name: Setup: Data Recovery
description: Raid FIB Headquarters to learn where Dre's stolen phone went and that three copies exist.

name: Nightlife Leak: The Nightclub
description: Secure security footage from a Triad-owned nightclub.

name: Nightlife Leak: The Marina
description: Steal a speedboat, board a Triad superyacht and photograph evidence.

name: Nightlife Leak Finale
description: Chase a promoter through the Diamond Casino and recover the backpack holding a copy of the phone.

name: High Society Leak: The Country Club
description: Grab footage from a country club, tail a limo to a Richman mansion and photograph its gate.

name: High Society Leak: Guest List
description: Tase a lawyer at a Vinewood Hills party and bring him to the Agency.

name: High Society Leak Finale
description: Crash a Richman party and chase a billionaire by helicopter to recover the next copy.

name: South Central Leak: Davis
description: Break up an Aztecas and Lost MC deal and steal a van loaded with meth equipment.

name: South Central Leak: The Ballas
description: Confront a Ballas set and find out the Vagos have the last copy.

name: South Central Leak Finale
description: Fight into Vagos turf in Rancho and take back the lowrider blasting Dre's unreleased music.

name: Studio Time
description: Defend Dre's recording studio from Johnny Guns' hired muscle.

name: Don't Fuck With Dre
description: Hunt Johnny Guns through a rail yard and an airport hangar and deliver him to Dre.

name: ULP - Intelligence
description: Hack Mason Duggan's computer, then search FIB sites for hardware and deliver it.

name: ULP - Counterintelligence
description: Hijack an FIB surveillance drone, follow the trail to a motel and defuse a bomb in a van.

name: ULP - Extraction
description: Search Agent Johnson's garage for clues, find him and get him to safety.

name: ULP - Asset Seizure
description: Locate the van carrying stolen hardware, steal it and deliver it.

name: ULP - Operation Paper Trail
description: Use ULP's drones to infiltrate a construction site, seize the Cliffford tech and take out Mason Duggan.

name: ULP - Cleanup
description: Restore power inside the Mount Chiliad silo, connect to Cliffford's servers and escape his mercenaries.

name: First Dose 1 - Welcome to the Troupe
description: Help Ron fight off the Lost MC, recover Dax's stolen Journey RV and escort Dax away.

name: First Dose 2 - Designated Driver
description: Steal party supplies for The Freakshop, then raid the Lost MC clubhouse and steal their weed.

name: First Dose 3 - Fatal Incursion
description: Wreck Lost MC property in Stab City, search Millar's Fishery for meth and steal a Dodo seaplane.

name: First Dose 4 - Uncontrolled Substance
description: A trippy mission chasing Dax through a hallucinatory rabbit-hole sequence.

name: First Dose 5 - Make War not Love
description: Destroy labs and vans at a hippy camp and the Altruist camp, then down the Altruists' Valkyrie.

name: First Dose 6 - Off the Rails
description: Infiltrate Humane Labs, recover chemicals from a train crash and steal the Brickade 6x6 Acid Lab.

name: Last Dose 1 - This is an Intervention
description: Deal with the kidnappers who hit The Freakshop and report back to Dax.

name: Last Dose 2 - Unusual Suspects
description: Search hideouts and an Elysian Island warehouse for clues to who kidnapped Labrat.

name: Last Dose 3 - Friedmind
description: Infiltrate FriedMind HQ in the Eclipse Medical Tower and rescue Labrat from the basement.

name: Last Dose 4 - Checking In
description: Follow Dax into the Parsons Rehabilitation Center for a surreal fight through clowns and aliens.

name: Last Dose 5 - BDKD
description: Hijack a cargo plane from LSIA, fly it to Sandy Shores and escort Dax's truck back to The Freakshop.

name: Reporting for Duty
description: Raid Davis Quartz quarry, destroy Merryweather supplies and take the Draugur to the LSA lockup.

name: Falling In
description: Disrupt Merryweather's anti-smuggler operations across Blaine County.

name: On Parade
description: Fly the F-160 Raiju through air defences and prove its capabilities against Merryweather.

name: Breaking Ranks
description: Intercept a Merryweather move and seize valuable military tech.

name: Unconventional Warfare
description: Infiltrate a building in Blaine County to rescue a hostage.

name: Shock & Awe
description: Launch the final assault on Merryweather's headquarters.

name: Slush Fund
description: Steal cash from two money-laundering fronts and bring it to Vincent's lockup.

name: Breaking and Entering
description: Gather a laptop, hacking device and a freight train for the raid while keeping the Terrorbyte alive.

name: Concealed Weapons
description: Steal the weapons and gear the crew will need for the raid.

name: Hit and Run
description: Steal the getaway vehicles for the farm raid.

name: Disorganized Crime
description: Obtain a keycard to the cocaine storage at the Cluckin' Bell plant.

name: Scene of the Crime
description: Storm the Cluckin' Bell factory, steal the cocaine, crack the safe and escape to Vincent's lockup.

name: The Brute Force File
description: A Garment Factory job with preps for private military armor, infiltration gear and an override key before the finale.

name: The Black Box File
description: Gather a hacking device, sonar equipment and a weaponized aircraft before recovering a black box in the finale.

name: The Fine Art File
description: Prepare EMP charges, an approach vehicle and facial recognition gear for an art-themed finale.

name: The Project Breakaway File
description: Prep mobile tracking, thermal charges and an encryption bypass before the Project Breakaway finale.

name: Up and Running
description: Intercept a Varrios Los Aztecas arms plane and try to sell its cargo, only for Eberhard to ruin the deal.

name: Setup: Mogul
description: Use a Velum to steal an Eberhard Mogul that will get the crew close to the Titan 250 D.

name: Setup: Intel
description: Hack an Eberhard base at the port for Titan 250 D data and salvage signal jammers from a sunken boat.

name: Setup: Iron Mule
description: Steal DH-7 Iron Mule helicopters from Eberhard's test site at Redwood Lights Track.

name: Setup: Ammunition
description: Use Iron Mule hooks to lift Titan 250 D ammunition off a cargo ship guarded by anti-aircraft trailers.

name: The Titan Job
description: Force down and seize the Titan 250 D, then use it to destroy Eberhard's submarine, train and MOC.

name: Liquid Market
description: Recover stolen whiskey from an Aztecas runner and hunt for the hidden bottles at a scrapyard.

name: ROI
description: Track a stolen Turismo Omaggio, sneak into the Diamond Casino for the keys and deliver the car.

name: Compound Interest
description: Protect a thief from the Triads while he opens a biometric box holding stolen casino diamonds.

name: Mutual Funds
description: Escort a flatbed carrying a bribe hidden in artwork from Madrazo's ranch while the Armenian Mob attacks.

name: Current Liabilities
description: Revive a beaten courier, get him to hospital and recover the stolen Epsilon money.

name: The Monopoly
description: Hit three Armenian Mob laundering fronts and defeat their boss at a construction site.

name: Negative Press
description: Remotely hijack a KnoWay self-driving taxi, wreck the company's cabs and billboards and escape the police.

name: Inside Job
description: Go undercover as a KnoWay goon and steal hard drives from a Cypress Flats data centre.

name: Tunnel Vision
description: Hack the driverless subway, stop the head engineer's train and take his briefcase.

name: Trash Talking
description: Pose as garbage collectors to steal confidential documents from KnoWay offices.

name: A Clean Break
description: Get arrested on purpose, break out of FIB interrogation, wipe KnoWay's data and flee to Avi's tugboat.

name: Home Sweet Home
description: A bonus mission for mansion owners: fight off a KnoWay ambush inside your own home with Michael De Santa.

name: Asset Recovery
description: Steal high-end vehicles from a police station and deliver them while rivals try to destroy them.

name: Executive Deathmatch
description: Challenge another organization to a team deathmatch to take down their boss.

name: Executive Search
description: Hide-and-seek: the boss hides inside a shrinking search area while other players hunt them.

name: Hostile Takeover
description: Retrieve a briefcase from a high-security location and deliver it before time runs out.

name: Piracy Prevention
description: Defend the deck of your yacht from anyone in the session trying to capture it.

name: Sightseer
description: Use a phone hacking app to track down and collect packages hidden around the map.

name: Headhunter
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Assassinate four marked targets across the map before the timer runs out.

name: Airfreight
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Hook a container to a Cargobob and fly it to the drop-off.

name: Haulage
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Hook up a trailer and drive it to the drop-off while rivals try to steal it.

name: Plowed
description: Use the Phantom Wedge to smash piles of crates at locations around the map.

name: Fully Loaded
description: Destroy turreted enemy vehicles from an armed Ruiner 2000.

name: Amphibious Assault
description: Destroy supplies with a Technical Aqua while rivals try to sink it.

name: Transporter
description: Drive a Wastelander carrying cargo vehicles to a destination within the time limit.

name: Fortified
description: Protect an Armored Boxville from attackers.

name: Velocity
description: Keep a bomb-rigged Rocket Voltic above 60 mph for ten minutes.

name: Ramped Up
description: Collect cargo crates using Ramp Buggies and Sanchez bikes.

name: Stockpiling
description: Grab cargo crates before rivals in a SecuroServ vehicle that self-destructs if abandoned.

name: Duo Dilligence
description: An organization challenge to collect the most flare-marked packages.

name: Courier Service
description: Carry a cash bag to a destination without getting hit; whatever cash is left is your score.

name: Point to Point
description: A point-to-point race between members of the organization.

name: Most Wanted
description: Members compete to survive a wanted level the longest.

name: Market Manipulation
description: Rob as many convenience stores as possible within the time limit.

name: Auto Buyout
description: Steal and deliver the most high-end cars before time runs out.

name: Cashing Out
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Hack the most ATMs for cash within the time limit.

name: Salvage
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Race to checkpoints to earn cash, with a bonus for the top scorer.

name: By the Pound
description: Steal product from the Ballas or meet an Aztecas contact and run it to a countryside drop-off.

name: Cracked
description: Crack a defended safe and move the cash bags to a drop-off.

name: Fragile Goods
description: Destroy a set of product vans before the timer runs out.

name: Guns for Hire
description: Escort two allied vehicles to a location and defend them from rival bikers.

name: Gunrunning
description: Disrupt an arms deal, steal the weapons and deliver them.

name: Jailbreak
description: Steal a prison bus and deliver the prisoner on board to a drop-off.

name: Nine Tenths of the Law
description: Steal a batch of motorcycles and deliver them.

name: Outrider
description: Carry contacts on the back of your bikes to a drop-off alive.

name: P.O.W.
description: Rescue a client held at a subway station, O'Neil Ranch or Mission Row PD and bring them to a safehouse.

name: Torched
description: Destroy ten crates of munitions at a location.

name: Weapon of Choice
payout: $2,000+ per target plus bonus for correct weapons
description: Assassinate targets using specific weapons for the full bonus.

name: Hit the Roof
description: Assault a rooftop gang, recover an Oppressor from a container and deliver it to the Duggans.

name: Life and Deathbikes
description: Steal an Apocalypse Deathbike from a rival workshop and use it to destroy the gang and their vehicles.

name: Asset Protection
description: Guard a business's cargo for ten minutes against waves of attackers; more surviving assets means more pay.

name: Gang Termination
description: Fight into a gang hideout and kill four high-ranking members.

name: Liquidize Assets
description: Tail a target to a rival operation, then plant explosives to destroy their goods.

name: Recover Valuables
description: Find a safe, track down its code and return the valuables to the Agency.

name: Rescue Operation
description: Locate a client under siege, kill the attackers and take the client to a safehouse.

name: Vehicle Recovery
description: Retrieve a stolen vehicle from a guarded building and bring it back to the Agency garage.

name: The CEO
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Kill a property developer filming a reality show on a construction site; the bonus asks for a staged accident.

name: The Cofounder
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Take out a tech cofounder leaving a motel; the bonus requires destroying his car with him inside.

name: The Judge
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Hit a judge playing golf at the Los Santos Golf Club; the bonus uses golf equipment.

name: The Popstar
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Kill a pop star cruising in a custom Euros; the bonus uses vehicle-based methods.

name: The Tech Entrepreneur
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Assassinate a tech founder; the bonus has you pose as his taxi driver.

name: The Trolls
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Hunt down a group of online trolls spread across the state against the clock.

name: The Dealers
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Ambush a Fooligan drug deal and kill all four dealers at the same time for the bonus.

name: The Hitmen
payout: $15,000 base + up to $30,000 bonus for the leader
description: Wipe out eight members of The Professionals travelling in four cars.

name: Short Trip - Seed Capital
description: Play as Franklin or Lamar to chase down a hijacked weed truck stolen by the Vagos.

name: Short Trip - Fire It Up
description: Burn the Vagos' weed warehouses in Blaine County and escape in one of their vans.

name: Short Trip - OG Kush
description: Meet celebrity Jimmy Boston about an endorsement and fight off a Vagos attack.

name: Bail Office Bounty - Bank Robbery
description: Bring in Kkangpae bank robbers who skipped bail.

name: Bail Office Bounty - Prison Bus
description: Track down Ballas convicts who escaped from a crashed prison bus.

name: Bail Office Bounty - CCTV
description: Use CCTV sightings to find violent street punks wanted for homicide and drug charges.

name: Bail Office Bounty - Clubhouse
description: Capture female Lost MC members with multiple felonies from the clubhouse.

name: Bail Office Bounty - Mansion Intimidation
description: Pressure wealthy women accused of fraud and embezzlement by wrecking assets at their mansions.

name: Bail Office Bounty - Arcade
description: Bring in Duggan family members hiding out in a Duggan hideout.

name: Most Wanted - Whitney
description: Find Grace Whitney, a CEO who faked her death to dodge bail, with stops at a morgue and her gallery.

name: Most Wanted - Song
description: Capture actress Cleo Song, wanted for tax fraud, on a Vinewood film lot.

name: Most Wanted - Thompson
description: Stop ex-boxer Brock Thompson's steroid convoy and bring him in for murder charges.

name: Most Wanted - Lieberman
description: Locate gambler Chaz Lieberman, who went dark while hiding from loan sharks.

name: Most Wanted - O'Neil
description: Hunt Leroy O'Neil through a motel and farmhouse to collect on his many bail bonds.

name: Most Wanted - Garcia
description: Run down street racer and car thief Omar Garcia via the LS Car Meet and test track.

name: Robbery in Progress
description: Use traffic cameras to find a bank robbery, take out the robbers and make off with the gold.

name: Data Sweep
description: Hack nearby vehicles with your phone to find the one carrying the target data drives.

name: Targeted Data
description: Fly a drone into the Lifeinvader office, hack laptops to identify a target and eliminate them.

name: Diamond Shopping
description: Use Terrorbyte drones to get into Vangelico, disable the alarm and steal the diamonds.

name: Collector's Pieces
description: Briefly kill an insurance jammer to locate Gruppe Sechs vans and seize the antiques inside.

name: Deal Breaker
description: Use the Terrorbyte scanner to pinpoint a deal, kill the target and take the security case.

name: Crop Dustin'
description: Spray herbicide over rival weed fields from a Duster, then destroy a tanker of fake vape liquid.

name: Heavy Metal
description: Recover a Bobcat XL full of copper wire and kill the gang leader who stole it.

name: Liquid Assets
description: Poison an Epsilon weed farm's water supply and survive the hallucinations that follow.

name: Working Remotely
description: Rig a GoPostal van with remote explosives, leave it in gang territory and blow it up.

name: Write-Off
description: Destroy Merryweather convoys and a depot full of pharmaceutical deliveries.

name: LSA Operation - Direct Action
description: Plant trackers on Merryweather shipments and steal an F-160 Raiju from an aircraft carrier.

name: LSA Operation - Surgical Strike
description: Disguise yourself as Merryweather to steal an artifact and photograph secret blueprints.

name: LSA Operation - Whistleblower
description: Expose Merryweather's secret contracts by raiding the IAA facility and uploading a virus.

name: Arms Trafficking: Destroy the Rival Shipments
description: Destroy weapon shipments being flown in by rival smugglers.

name: Arms Trafficking: Steal the Weapons
description: Steal a DH-7 Iron Mule from smugglers and use it to grab their weapons shipment.

name: Arms Trafficking: Deliver the Weapons
description: Clear a gang from a cargo drop, flare in the smuggler plane and sell the goods to Oscar's buyers.

name: Arms Trafficking: Steal the Duster 300-H
description: Break up an arms deal, steal the Duster 300-H and use it to sell the cargo.

name: Hands On Car Wash: Recover the Cash (Stockade)
description: Use a Stockade to collect dirty money from three banks.

name: Hands On Car Wash: Recover the Cash (Stash Car)
description: Collect dirty money hidden in a car at the docks.

name: Hands On Car Wash: Steal the Rival's Cash
description: Rob a rival money-laundering operation.

name: Hands On Car Wash: Torch the Rival Operation
description: Burn piles of fake cash inside and outside a rival front.

name: Higgins Helitours: Recover the Cargo
description: Find and collect a shipment of laundered money.

name: Higgins Helitours: Recover the Helicopter
description: Take back a helicopter impounded by the LSPD.

name: Higgins Helitours: Deliver the Cargo
description: Fly a fresh shipment of laundered money to its destination.

name: Higgins Helitours: Recover the Cash Case
description: Locate a dirty money drop and pull the cash case out of a rival hideout.

name: Smoke on the Water: Torch the Weed Farms
description: Burn the plants at rival weed farms.

name: Smoke on the Water: Collect the Fertilizer
description: Steal fertilizer canisters loaded on a Bobcat XL.

name: Smoke on the Water: Recover the Product
description: Retrieve weed packages that have cash stashed inside.

name: Smoke on the Water: Eliminate the Rival Dealers
description: Kill rival dealers from a lowrider so a street gang gets the blame.

name: Nightclub Promotion (Tony Prince)
description: Short jobs from the club computer, like posters, flyers, blimp music and supply runs, that boost club popularity.

name: Celebrity & VIP Pickups (Lazlow)
description: Once the club is very popular, Lazlow sends you to collect VIPs and find or rescue celebrities.

name: Help Your DJ (English Dave)
description: One-off calls to recover stolen equipment or rescue a resident DJ's friends.

name: Nightclub Security (Marcel)
description: Quick bouncer jobs: drive a passed-out patron home or throw out a troublemaker.

name: Special Cargo Source & Sell
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: CEO crate missions: source crates for a warehouse, then sell them in bulk to buyers.

name: Vehicle Cargo Steal & Export
description: Steal requested high-end cars for your vehicle warehouse and export them to buyers.

name: MC Business Resupply & Sell
description: Steal supplies for drug and counterfeit businesses, then deliver the finished product to buyers.

name: Bunker Resupply & Sell
description: Steal supplies for your Bunker, then deliver the weapons it produces.

name: Hangar Air Freight
description: Steal air cargo for your Hangar and sell it, usually by flying it to the buyer.

name: Nightclub Goods Delivery
description: Sell stock gathered by your nightclub warehouse technicians to buyers across the map.

name: Acid Lab Resupply & Sell
description: Gather supplies for the Brickade 6x6 Acid Lab and deliver the product.

name: Checkpoints
description: Collect as many checkpoints as possible across a section of the map by land or sea.

name: Air Checkpoints
description: An aircraft-only version of Checkpoints scattered across the sky.

name: Criminal Damage
description: Cause the most property damage before the time limit runs out.

name: Hold the Wheel
description: Steal a marked vehicle and keep hold of it for the longest time.

name: Hot Property
description: Grab a briefcase on foot and hold it for longer than everyone else.

name: Hunt the Beast
description: One player becomes the Beast and must reach landmarks while everyone else tries to kill them.

name: Kill List
description: Use an armed vehicle to destroy Merryweather patrols.

name: King of the Castle
description: Capture a marked area and defend it for the longest time.

name: Dead Drop
description: A removed event where players grabbed a package on foot and raced it to a drop-off.

name: Kill List Competitive
description: A removed competitive Kill List where teams raced to destroy the most Merryweather patrols.

name: Moving Target
description: A removed event to steal a target vehicle and deliver it to a drop-off.

name: Penned In
description: A removed event where drivers had to stay inside a moving, shrinking sphere.

name: Freemode Challenges
description: Quick random contests such as longest wheelie, longest jump or highest speed.

name: Business Battles
description: Session-wide fights over drops of business goods that nightclub owners can add to their warehouse.

name: Phantom Car
description: A Halloween night-time event where a possessed car hunts players through the streets.

name: Slasher (Halloween)
description: A seasonal event in which a masked slasher stalks the player on foot after dark.

name: The Gooch
description: A festive random event where a holiday creature steals your cash and snacks until you take it down.

name: Happy Holidays Hauler
description: A festive truck that drives around dropping free gifts for nearby players.

name: Yeti Hunt
description: A one-time festive murder mystery that ends with tracking down and killing a yeti.

name: MC Deathmatch
description: Your MC challenges another club or organization to a team deathmatch.

name: Joust
description: A motorcycle-only deathmatch against another MC.

name: Stand Your Ground
description: Your MC holds an area against other players for 20 minutes.

name: Caged In
description: A biker take on Penned In, where riders must stay inside a shrinking area.

name: Criminal Mischief
description: Club members race to hit the most vehicles with bike melee attacks.

name: Hit & Ride
description: Score the most drive-by kills on gang members from a motorcycle.

name: On The Run
description: Survive a five-star wanted level on a bike for the longest time.

name: Race to Point
description: Club members race to the clubhouse or a random location.

name: Rippin' It Up
description: Cause the most property damage while riding.

name: Search and Destroy
description: Hunt down photo-identified targets, with bonus points for headshots and melee kills.

name: Wheelie Rider
description: Pull off the longest wheelie within five minutes.

name: Bargaining Chips
description: Find five people around town who stole chips and kill or threaten them.

name: Best Laid Plans
description: Take a key card from a crew member, clear a building and hack a laptop to locate more targets.

name: Fake News
description: Find a Weazel News van, kill the reporter and take his wallet.

name: High Rollin'
description: Chauffeur a high-roller to the casino in a Stretch limo without speeding or crashing.

name: Judgment Call
description: Sneak past a judge's guards and threaten him.

name: Lost in Transit
description: Stop attackers hitting a Stockade and drive the truck to the casino.

name: One Armed Bandits
description: Lift a shipping container of slot machines with a Skylift and fly it to the casino.

name: Recovery Time
description: Get a guest's stolen car back from the impound or from Vagos turf and deliver it intact.

name: Safe Bet
description: Escort a Stockade full of chips to the casino while enemies chase it.

name: Severance
description: Chase down a fleeing ex-dealer on a Sanchez and return the chips he took.

name: Undisclosed Cargo
description: Drive a car with a body in the trunk to a quiet spot without being spotted by police.

name: When the Chips are Down
description: Raid a counterfeit chip factory and destroy its machines.

name: Damage Control
description: A secret job triggered after drinking at the casino bar: wake up in Blaine County and return a stolen Mule.

name: Under the Influence
description: A secret job where you stay drunk until you deliver a client's car.

name: Tour de Force
description: A secret job unlocked late in the casino story: give a client a city tour in a Swift Deluxe.

name: Department of Defense
description: A removed Casino Work job to kill a group of Professionals and chase a Speedo to a second group.

name: Officer Monitored
description: Recover surveillance footage that incriminates crooked LSPD officers from a gang hideout.

name: Possession for Sale
description: Seize narcotics from a drug deal that corrupt cops are protecting.

name: Civil Disturbance
description: Eliminate three informants working for dirty cops.

name: Malicious Mischief
description: Defuse explosives to break up a police-backed insurance scam.

name: Health Code Violations
description: Confiscate a taco van used to move narcotics.

name: Obstruction of Justice
description: Rescue Vincent's informant from the middle of a gang shootout.

name: Protective Custody
description: Drive a corrupt cop to Bolingbroke Penitentiary in the Police Transporter.

name: Civil Forfeiture
description: Use a Buzzard attack chopper to take out a corrupt cop.

name: Taxi Work
description: Pick up and drop off fares as a Downtown Cab Co. driver.

name: Pizza This...
payout: $2,000 per delivery + $10,000 for all five on time
description: Deliver five pizzas by Pizza Boy scooter within ten minutes from one of three pizzerias.

name: QuickiePharm Medical Courier
description: Rush prescription deliveries to customers for QuickiePharm.

name: Safeguard Deliveries
description: Run cash and valuables deliveries for Gruppe Sechs or Bobcat Security.

name: Firefighter
description: Answer Los Santos Fire Department calls to help citizens in trouble.

name: Forklift Operator
description: Load Alpha Mail delivery vans at the warehouse near LSIA.

name: Paper Route
description: Pick up papers at the Los Santos Meteor office in Strawberry and deliver them to subscribers.

name: Come Out to Play
description: Runners on foot try to reach a destination while Hunters on bikes and ATVs try to stop them.

name: Siege Mentality
description: Defenders hold a position against attackers who have unlimited lives but only sawn-off shotguns.

name: Hasta la Vista
description: Cyclists race for a finish while truckers in big rigs try to flatten them.

name: Cross the Line
description: Teams try to get every member across a neutral zone into enemy territory.

name: Hunting Pack
description: A team escorts a rigged vehicle that explodes if it slows down, while attackers try to ram it.

name: Keep the Pace
description: Racers must stay above a minimum speed on hazard-filled courses or explode.

name: Relay
description: Teammates take turns driving laps and tagging in the next racer.

name: Offense Defense
description: Each team's runner races to the finish while armoured protectors block rival runners.

name: Slasher
description: A shotgun-armed killer hunts players who only have flashlights until the tables turn.

name: Running Back
description: A runner in a small car tries to reach the end zone while blockers clear the way.

name: Every Bullet Counts
description: Four players in a tight arena get a pistol with very few bullets before switching to melee.

name: Extraction
description: Bodyguards escort a VIP to an extraction point while a hit squad tries to kill them.

name: Beast vs. Slasher
description: Fast, leaping Beasts evade heavily armed Slashers.

name: Drop Zone
description: Teams parachute in and fight to control a drop zone.

name: Till Death Do Us Part
description: Couples fight as pairs; if one partner dies, both are out.

name: Rhino Hunt
description: A team armed with sticky bombs tries to take down players driving Rhino tanks.

name: Sumo
description: Push rivals off a raised platform and be the last car standing.

name: Inch by Inch
description: Teams fight over a package and try to carry it into their end zone.

name: In and Out
description: Attackers raid enemy turf to steal packages while defenders guard them.

name: Trading Places
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Losers try to kill Winners in order to swap places with them.

name: Power Play
dlc: Further Adventures in Finance and Felony
description: Teams fight using power-ups that boost damage, speed or defence.

name: Entourage
description: Bodyguards protect a target on the way to an extraction while assassins hunt them.

name: Slipstream
description: Teams of bikers race and use each other's slipstream for boosts.

name: Lost Vs Damned
description: Angels and Devils fight as the day-night cycle gives each side the advantage in turn.

name: Deadline
description: Tron-style bikes leave deadly light trails; force opponents to crash into yours.

name: Kill Quota
description: Teams progress through weapons by reaching kill quotas.

name: Turf Wars
description: Drive over tiles to paint them your team's colour while defending your own.

name: Juggernaut
description: Each team protects its heavily armoured Juggernaut while trying to kill the enemy's.

name: Vehicle Vendetta
description: Car combat in an arena using pickups and weapons.

name: Collection Time
description: Kill rivals to collect points and hold them all to win.

name: Resurrection
description: Wipe out the enemy team, while fallen allies can be revived by scoring kills.

name: Land Grab
description: Teams compete to claim the most territory in a digital arena.

name: Tiny Racers
description: A top-down retro race where falling off-screen eliminates you.

name: Dawn Raid
description: Teams parachute into a dark warzone and fight to secure a crate of cash.

name: Overtime Rumble
description: Launch sports cars off a ramp and parachute onto a scoring platform.

name: Power Mad
description: Teams fight for a pickup that turns its holder into a minigun-armed Juggernaut.

name: Overtime Shootout
description: Take turns launching cars to land on a small bullseye platform.

name: Motor Wars
description: A battle-royale style mode where teams parachute in, scavenge weapons and vehicles and fight to the last team.

name: Bombushka Run
description: Teams take turns flying a heavily armed Bombushka bomber or attacking it in helicopters.

name: Stockpile
description: Collect loot and bring it to your base while stealing from rivals' stashes.

name: Condemned
description: Whoever is Condemned must kill another player to pass it on before their timer expires.

name: Dogfight
description: Aerial team combat in fighter planes.

name: Occupy
description: Teams capture and hold zones to earn points.

name: Slashers
description: Flashlight-wielding players flee shotgun-armed killers until the roles swap.

name: Air Quota
description: Teams rack up kills using jets, helicopters and the Thruster jetpack.

name: Hardest Target
description: Each team must protect its marked player, who changes every minute, while killing the enemy's.

name: The Vespucci Job
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: A lone getaway driver hits checkpoints while police cars try to stop them.

name: Trap Door
dlc: Southern San Andreas Super Sport Series
description: Fight on a crumbling platform where the last team standing wins.

name: Hunting Pack (Remix)
description: A remixed Hunting Pack with heavier vehicles and stunt-filled routes.

name: Trading Places (Remix)
description: A remixed Trading Places where Losers become Beasts hunting Juggernaut Winners.

name: Running Back (Remix)
description: A remixed Running Back with hazard-filled tunnels and supercar blockers.

name: Sumo (Remix)
description: A remixed Sumo where players must end each round inside a moving, shrinking zone.

name: Carnage (Arena War)
description: An Arena War free-for-all in heavily armed vehicles.

name: Flag War (Arena War)
description: Capture the flag inside the Maze Bank Arena.

name: Games Masters (Arena War)
description: One team runs checkpoints while the other operates arena traps, swapping each round.

name: Here Come the Monsters (Arena War)
description: Monster trucks hunt a team of small cars that must survive.

name: Hot Bomb (Arena War)
description: Pass a ticking bomb by ramming other cars before it goes off.

name: Wreck It (Arena War)
description: Race to the finish while wrecking other competitors.

name: Tag Team (Arena War)
description: One driver per team fights in the arena and can tag in a teammate.

name: Buzzer Beater (Arena War)
description: Every driver fights a personal countdown that can be extended; run out of time and you are out.

name: Bomb Ball (Arena War)
description: Teams push an explosive ball into the opposing half of the arena before it detonates.

name: Double Down
description: Two players as Franklin and Lamar hold off endless attackers with heavy weapons.

name: The Vespucci Job (Remix)
description: A remixed Vespucci Job with a muscle car getaway driver.

name: Judgement Day
description: Riders hunt a group of survivors who must last until dawn.

name: Assault on Cayo Perico
description: Large-scale attack and defence battle across the beaches of Cayo Perico.

name: Assault on ATT-16
description: A multi-stage assault on an aircraft carrier ending in stealing a jet from its hangar.

name: Hunting Pack (Get Lamar)
description: Lamar tries to deliver a burning van while rival gangs chase him down.

name: Motor Wars (Cayo Perico)
description: A Cayo Perico version of Motor Wars with shrinking zones across the island.

name: Mansion Raid
description: Attackers break into a luxury mansion to reach the vault and steal gold while defenders hold them off.

name: Deadline Duet
description: A two-player-team version of Deadline on light-trail bikes.
